lines.text: E-Endmin?! You're here!
This is a super important portal! I told them but none of them believed! They even laughed at me!
A Protocol ... Space? What's that...? Oh! I almost forgot about my special self-intro!
The name's Algernon, smartest kid of the UW and upcoming Endfielder! Reporting for duty, Endmin!
I just noticed this portal. I'm now guarding it so that nobody gets too close, Endmin!
Heheh... I read Carly's fairytales. This portal is definitely connected to the Rooted Realm.
Carly's book mentioned a Big, Big Oak that once grew in Valley IV many, many years ago...
These gemstones are memories of the Big, Big Oak. The happy memories are sweet, but the sad memories are bitter...
According to the book, only the smartest kid can find the way in. And that kid happens to be me! I found it, you see!
This must be a super important portal, right? I heard about the story where you planted the Great Originium Oak. Did you create this portal as well?
Does it contain a treasure hoard? I think it has one 'cos I can't enter it. Did you lock it?
Oh ... really? But learning the Originium Arts is really hard...
But I'll put in some serious effort! So, are you going in to complete your mission, Endmin?
Got it, Endmin! I'll stand guard while you're gone!
In the shadow of the Big, Big Oak, there's a theme park filled with shiny, candy-flavored gemstones...

options: So, my upcoming Endfielder, what are you doing here?
Master the Originium Arts and you'll get in.

r: So, my upcoming Endfielder, what are you doing here?

lines.text: Endmin, are you going to start your mission?
Incredible, Endmin!
According to the book, only the bravest soul will find their way in the Big Oak's memories! And you did it so easily!
I'll master the Originium Arts quickly! Next time, it'll be my turn to complete the mission for you!
Awesome, Endmin! You made it look like a walk in the park!
Endmin! You completed the mission! Did you find any super sweet gemstones?
No strange incidents nearby, Endmin! I wish you success on your mission!
